items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps easily flushed, dry-feeling skin comfortable.
A soothing gel that gives a calming, cooling feel to skin that looks red when warm.
A light ceramide moisturizer that supports the skin barrier and adds comfort to dry, sensitive-feeling skin.
A mineral SPF 50 gives gentle daily sun protection, since sun and heat can make skin look redder.

response.routine_note: Use the cleanser, soothing gel and moisturizer morning and night, then apply the mineral SPF as the last step each morning. Redness that flares with heat or wine is best looked at by a dermatologist, so we've kept this routine minimal and skipped actives that could add irritation.
